Brother Kills Sister in Meerut, Claims Honor Motive

A 21-year-old man in Meerut has confessed to strangling his 19-year-old sister to death. The accused reportedly told police that he killed her due to her alleged romantic relationship with a neighbor, which he claimed was bringing shame to the family. He subsequently surrendered to the police and admitted to the crime.
